findings.summary: review_summarizer._REVIEW_LINE_RE uses `$` anchor which rejects real-queue lines that have ' — description' suffix after task_id. Real-queue parsing returns task_count=0 even when queue is non-empty.
findings.fix: Remove `$` from _REVIEW_LINE_RE or make suffix-tolerant (e.g., allow optional ' — .*' after task_id).

findings.fix: Add `'fetch_errors': []` to the empty-queue early-return dict.
